episode_summary: Brenton Miebach shares his journey of breaking into new real estate markets using AI-driven strategies and social media. He discusses how he replaced traditional roles with AI systems and rapidly grew his social media presence by leveraging local historical content. This episode offers actionable insights for agents looking to innovate and scale their business.
